recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1970s album cover featuring a trio portrait against a solid black background, topped with heavy, stylized display typography. The aesthetic is defined by warm, analog film tones and a high-contrast layout that prioritizes the band's identity and album title in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy upper third balanced by centered subjects below
High-contrast white lettering against a deep black void
Warm skin tones and earth-toned clothing against a neutral background
coreInvariants: Heavyweight display typeface with rounded terminals
Analog film grain and slight edge wear

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned in the lower two-thirds, centered horizontally, scaled to fill the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold primary title at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting at the large white title, moving to the secondary title, and resting on the faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the subjects, creating a stark, isolated studio feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm browns, reds, and skin tones (subjects)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with natural, warm saturation in the foreground subjects; high value contrast between text and background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, high-contrast serif with rounded, bulbous features
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with very thin connectors
Slightly irregular, hand-cut feel to the edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a large, circular bowl
Uppercase 'E' with heavy horizontal bars and rounded ends
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use a slightly smaller version of the same typeface or a complementary bold sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the vintage flair and thick serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three men with long hair and 70s attire (denim, plaid, leather) against a solid black background. The lighting should be warm and soft, mimicking 35mm film. Leave the top 30% of the frame as empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-bold white text in a Cooper Black style at the top. The primary title should be largest, with a secondary title centered immediately below it in a slightly smaller size.

verificationChecks: Is the typography heavy and rounded?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?
Are the subjects centered and looking at the camera?

mustRedesign: Original band names and album titles
Unique facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ring wear' texture on the edges
Verify the typography has the characteristic 70s bulbous serifs
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered studio portrait on black with oversized, high-contrast 70s display type and a layer of analog film grain.
